headline: Colombian banking sector profits reach 12.8 trillion pesos through third quarter
summary: Colombian financial institutions generated over 12.8 trillion pesos in cumulative net income through the third quarter, led by Bancolombia with 5.9 trillion pesos, Davivienda with 1.7 trillion, and Banco de Bogotá with 1 trillion.
why: Bank earnings in Colombia illustrate credit recovery, loan loss provisioning, and net interest margin dynamics under prevailing monetary conditions.
